# Requirement: D2:D13 should ignore corresponding blank cells in column A.

        f'=IF(LEN(A{row})=0,"",',

import os
import math
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import range_boundaries

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/32255/1_32255_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/32255_0_c54b89f8/1_32255_output.xlsx"
answer_range = "D2:D13"

# 1) INSPECT
wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb.active

wb_data = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)
ws_data = wb_data[ws.title]

min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

print("Sheet:", ws.title)
print("Dimensions:", ws.max_row, ws.max_column)
print("Answer range:", answer_range)
print("Relevant input values/formulas:")
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    print(
        f"Row {r}: "
        f"A formula={ws.cell(r, 1).value!r}, "
        f"D formula={ws.cell(r, min_col).value!r}, "
        f"D cached={ws_data.cell(r, min_col).value!r}"
    )

# 2) SOLVE
# In every answer cell D(row), preserve the existing formula/value as the result when A(row)
# contains data, but return blank when A(row) is blank.

def is_blank(v):
    return v is None or (isinstance(v, str) and v == "")

def already_guarded(formula, row):
    if not isinstance(formula, str) or not formula.startswith("="):
        return False
    compact = formula.replace(" ", "").upper()
    return (
        compact.startswith(f'=IF(A{row}="","",')
        or compact.startswith(f'=IF($A{row}="","",')
        or compact.startswith(f'=IF(ISBLANK(A{row}),"",')
        or compact.startswith(f'=IF(ISBLANK($A{row}),"",')
        or compact.startswith(f'=IF(LEN(A{row})=0,"",')
        or compact.startswith(f'=IF(LEN($A{row})=0,"",')
    )

def excel_literal(v):
    if is_blank(v):
        return '""'
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return "TRUE" if v else "FALSE"
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
        if isinstance(v, float) and (math.isnan(v) or math.isinf(v)):
            return '""'
        return repr(v)
    return '"' + str(v).replace('"', '""') + '"'

for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(r, min_col)
    old = cell.value

    if isinstance(old, str) and old.startswith("="):
        if not already_guarded(old, r):
            cell.value = f'=IF(A{r}="","",{old[1:]})'
    else:
        cell.value = f'=IF(A{r}="","",{excel_literal(old)})'

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# 3) VERIFY
out_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
out_ws = out_wb.active
out_data = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True).active

print("\nOutput answer range:")
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    print(
        f"A{r}={out_ws.cell(r, 1).value!r}, "
        f"D{r}={out_ws.cell(r, min_col).value!r}, "
        f"cached={out_data.cell(r, min_col).value!r}"
    )

blank_check_done = False
nonblank_check_done = False

for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    a_val = out_ws.cell(r, 1).value
    d_val = out_ws.cell(r, min_col).value

    if is_blank(a_val) and not blank_check_done:
        print(
            f"\nManual check blank row {r}: A{r} is blank, "
            f"so D{r} is guarded to return blank until A{r} has data: {d_val!r}"
        )
        blank_check_done = True

    if not is_blank(a_val) and not nonblank_check_done:
        print(
            f"Manual check nonblank row {r}: A{r} has data, "
            f"so D{r} keeps its original calculation/value behind the guard: {d_val!r}"
        )
        nonblank_check_done = True

print("\nSaved:", output_path)
print("Only cells in D2:D13 were modified, and each written formula was derived from the input workbook.")
